results.title: Node.js Previous Releases
excerpts: Major Node.js versions enter Current release status for six months, which gives library authors time to add support for them.
After six months, odd-numbered releases become unsupported, and even-numbered releases move to Active LTS status.
Node.js 22 (Iron) entered LTS on 2024-10-29. Maintenance LTS begins 2025-10-21. End-of-life is scheduled for 2027-04-30.
Production applications should only use Active LTS or Maintenance LTS releases.
